title: NASA Spaceport Infrastructure, Maintenance, and Operations Acquisition
summary: NASA's SIMO page describes the planned follow-on acquisition for facility, infrastructure, utility, logistics, and technical support across Kennedy and Cape Canaveral, with service no earlier than April 2027.
key_findings: NASA identifies SIMO as the planned follow-on to the current BOSS contract.
The planned fixed-price service would support more than 30 government and commercial customers across about 220 square miles.
NASA was still seeking industry feedback, so the record does not establish a solicitation award or service start.
why_it_matters: It exposes the operating-services layer needed to keep a multi-user spaceport available.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a named infrastructure-operations procurement trail.
Connects capital assets to maintenance, utilities, logistics, and customer support.
Creates later solicitation, award, transition, and performance checks.
evidence_limits: The page is a planned acquisition, not an executed contract.
It does not prove service start, performance, availability, or customer outcomes.
